title: tilia tuan var. chinensis
intro: Tilia tuan var. chinensis, commonly known as Chinese Linden, is a deciduous tree species native to China. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include relieving anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, as well as lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Linden include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Chinese Linden, including flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
